name: Billionbrains Garage Ventures Ltd. (Groww)
business_summary: Groww is India's largest discount broker by active clients (model knowledge: ~26% of NSE active clients) - a digital investing platform for stocks, F&O, mutual funds, bonds, IPOs, US stocks, MTF and wealth. Listed November 2025 (model knowledge: IPO ~Rs100/share); Q2 FY27 PAT Rs725cr (+54% y/y), revenue Rs1,502cr (+47%), OPM 64%. Mcap Rs1.40 lakh cr, P/E 52x. Promoters 27.1%, FIIs 10.9% (from 2.5% in March), DIIs 12.7%. Early investors (Peak XV, Sequoia) are selling via blocks (Rs1,999cr on 2026-09-16, stock -4.5%).

revenue_mix.segment: MF distribution, bonds, wealth, interest and other

exposures.mechanism: +20% traded value/demat additions: broking ~75% of revenue (F&O heavy; model knowledge); revenue +15% = ~Rs860cr on TTM Rs5,724cr; incremental margin ~85% => EBITDA +Rs730cr = +20% on Rs3,596cr; EV/MCap ~0.98; persistence 0.5 => +9.

evidence.note: Q2 PAT +54% y/y to Rs725cr, revenue +47%; F&O pressure 'temporary', MTF and AI in focus (ET/Business Upturn)

exposures.mechanism: F&O is the highest-ARPU product; a tightening step cuts volumes ~10% => revenue -6%, EBITDA -9% x 0.75 persistence, plus de-rating at P/E 52x => -8. MOFSL (2026-10-13) sees regulatory overhang easing.

evidence.note: NDTV Profit: MOFSL 25% upside as overhang eases
SEBI panel view on CAS; settlement may move to last-30-minute VWAP; BSE +2.8% (NiftyTrader 2026-10-15; Moneycontrol 2026-10-06)

exposures.mechanism: STT/capital-gains tax step lowers trader returns and turnover => -5 (same chain as BSE, slightly lower since MTF and MF distribution diversify).

Zerodha, Angel One, Upstox, banks and the freshly listed NSE-linked ecosystem compete on pricing; a broad fee cut hits ARPU (flat brokerage already); +1 step => revenue -6% at ~100% drop-through => EBITDA -10%, persistence 0.5 => -5 (new node proposed).
+10% SIP+DII inflows: MF distribution, client growth, cash volumes: +3.
Household savings shifting into equities/MF/bonds is the core thesis: Groww added bonds, MTF and derivatives; +1 => revenue CAGR +5pp, persistence 1.0 on valuation => +4.
FIIs rose from 2.5% to 10.9% in two quarters post-IPO; flow-sensitive; +2.5.

Interest income on own cash and client float rises with rates (size not disclosed in pack); MTF funding costs also rise (MTF scaling noted on Q2 call; interest expense only Rs5cr/qtr so book mostly equity funded) => net +0.5 offset by de-rating.
1y vol 48%; risk-off cuts new-client additions; vol spikes raise short-term trading. Net -2.
US-stock investing via platform (not significant); global risk appetite; +1.
Employee/tech costs ~20% of costs; +2pp wage inflation on ~20% of costs (~37% of revenue) => EBITDA -1%; with AI-talent hiring premium and persistence 0.75 => -1.5.
Groww Credit/NBFC arm and payments entity (model knowledge) sit under RBI/SEBI rules; small.
